summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — PHIA.AS +7%, BAYN.DE +7%, MC.PA +5%, SAF.PA +5%, HEI.DE +5%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (ZAL.DE -6%, ITH.L -6%, BP.L -4%, SHELL.AS -4%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: PHIA.AS (+6.95%) — No confirmed catalyst: searches found no 2026-11-04 Philips news. Likely a Q3 2026 results/guidance reaction or sector move, but I couldn't verify that. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: Philips is a large-cap Euronext Amsterdam (AEX) healthtech name, and no uk-eu strategy lists it. If it was a results gap, pre-market positioning would also have beaten post-open signals.
